newsitem.title: CHINA: China real estate investment up 18.3 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China real estate investment up 18.3 pct in 1996.

text.p: Investment in China's real estate sector rose 18.3 percent in 1996 to 372.5 billion yuan ($44.9 billion) compared with 1995, Qiu Xiaohua, spokesman for the State Statistical Bureau, said on Monday.
Qiu said he was optimistic about the outlook for China's real estate industry in 1997 because the government had decided to boost economic growth in part by developing urban real estate.
A recent move by the government to reduce the myriad taxes imposed on property projects was also a boon for the industry, but its performance in 1997 hinged on market demand, Qiu said.
China's property market is widely expected to rebound in 1997 after a slump in the last couple of years.
